settings.title: The Boundary Blueprint

settings.editor:
Overgiving. Overcommitting. Overexplaining. You’re not broken—you’re just ready for the boundary blueprint: a structured approach to building healthy limits.

In this high-touch course—rooted in clinical expertise and delivered through personalized coaching—you’ll learn to set strong boundaries and apply them with clarity and confidence.

settings.title:
What is The
Boundary Blueprint?

settings.editor: An 8-week course rooted in clinical expertise and delivered through personalized 1:1 coaching—designed to help you:

icon_list.text: Say “no” without guilt, awkwardness, or burnout.
Stop taking on other people’s stress, drama, and to-do lists.
Spot boundary violations before they spiral.
Create space for your own needs, peace, and creativity.
Build relationships based on respect, not obligation.

settings.editor: All taught by Dana Skaggs, a master's level psychotherapist who has had 15 years of professional experience as well as significant personal knowledge of how boundaries can save our lives.
Whether you're looking for expert support, deep transformation, or a shared journey with your partner, we’ve got you covered.

settings.title: How it Works

icon_list.text: Once you sign up, you’ll receive instant access to the course portal and a short onboarding questionnaire to help Dana personalize your coaching experience.
Schedule your private 1:1 coaching calls based on your availability using our Calendar Scheduling System—these high-touch sessions are where we apply the material directly to your life.
Start learning right away with 14 video modules—rooted in clinical expertise and designed to complement your 1:1 coaching—as they walk you through the foundations of healthy, confident boundaries.

settings.editor:
Dana is called the Queen of Boundaries because of her extraordinary skill at helping her clients understand how the lack of healthy boundaries contributes to their problems.

She has been in private practice for over 15 years, specializing in anxiety and adjustment issues as well as trauma work.

tabs.tab_title: How do the coaching calls work?
tabs.tab_content: After you enroll, you'll receive access to Dana’s scheduling calendar (via Calendly) to book your private coaching calls. Each call is 90 minutes and tailored to help you apply the course content to your specific challenges.

tabs.tab_title: When do I get access to the course?
tabs.tab_content: You’ll get instant access to all modules and your onboarding materials as soon as you sign up—no waiting required.

tabs.tab_title: How long do I have access to the course content?
tabs.tab_content: You have lifetime access to the course materials, so you can revisit the tools and lessons anytime you need a refresher.

tabs.tab_title: Is this course appropriate for couples?
tabs.tab_content: Yes—the Unity package is specifically designed for couples who want to reset boundaries and improve their connection together, with joint coaching support.

tabs.tab_title: What’s the difference between the packages?
tabs.tab_content: All packages include the full course. The biggest differences are the number of private coaching calls and Boundary Boosters. The Unity Package is designed for couples.

Boundary Boosters are scheduled 15-minute Zoom calls. Clients will complete a short form prior to the call to identify the specific issue or boundary challenge. If they need further support, they can purchase a full coaching session. All Boundary Booster sessions must be scheduled within 60 days of enrollment.

tabs.tab_title: Can I do the course without the coaching calls?
tabs.tab_content: Yes, the Boundary Blueprint course is available for purchase at learn.danaskaggs.com. However, clients see the strongest results when the course is paired with personalized coaching. To book a session, visit danaskaggs.com/coaching.
